description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of “Task Type” for Agency B, showing three categories in total. The largest slice is labeled “Article generation (82.9%)” and is colored salmon/red; a smaller slice is labeled “Article editing (14.6%)” and is colored light blue; and a very thin slice is labeled “Headline generation (2.4%)” and is colored pale yellow. The chart places the title text “Task Type” in bold at the center of the donut, and the category names with percentages are written outside the ring rather than in a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond their size and color. Visually, the slices appear arranged with the dominant “Article generation” segment spanning most of the circle, followed by the blue “Article editing” segment and then the small yellow “Headline generation” segment.
